core.title: Chooser of the Slain
core.daily.label: Daily #{n}
rule.return: The living go back. Stamp RETURN.
rule.ran: The drowned belong to Rán. Stamp RÁN.
rule.folkvangr: A worthy soul who matches Freyja's whim of the day is hers. Stamp FÓLKVANGR.
rule.valhalla: The worthy go to Valhalla: fell in battle, weapon in hand, and (from day 2) never fled. Stamp VALHALLA.
rule.hel: Everyone else goes to Hel. Stamp HEL.
law.fever: A fever flush means sickness took them.
law.foam: Sea-foam on the lips means the sea took them.
law.dryLips: Dry lips mean they did not drown.
law.breath: If the feather stirs at their lips, they still breathe.
law.noBreath: If the feather lies still, they are dead.
law.wounded: Fresh wounds mean they fell fighting, or went into the sea fighting.
law.unwounded: No wounds anywhere means no battle took them.
tm.identity.3: They called me {name}. {patronym}, if you're writing it down.
tm.death.battle.1: I held the shield wall at {place} until {foe} broke it. And me.
tm.death.battle.2: Nine of {foe} I felled at {place} before the tenth got lucky.
tm.death.battle.3: Axe to the ribs, holding {place}. Is this Valhalla? It smells like {place}.
tm.death.battle.4: Spear through the gut at {place}. Quick, at least.
tm.death.sickness.1: The coughing sickness. Three weeks of it.
tm.death.sickness.2: Fever. I'd rather not talk about the rest.
tm.death.oldAge.1: I went in my sleep. Seventy winters is enough for anyone.
tm.death.drowned.1: The sea took me off {place}. Cold, then nothing.
tm.weapon.yes.1: I died with my {weapon} in my hand.
tm.weapon.yes.2: My {weapon} never left my grip. Check if you like.
tm.weapon.no.1: My {weapon} went into the mud before the end.
tm.back.no.1: I never turned my back on them. Not once.
tm.flavor.confused: Where are the tables? I was told there would be tables.
tm.flavor.braggart: Write that down. All of it.
tm.flavor.coward: Is there a quieter hall? Somewhere without spears?
rv.huginn.battle: Huginn: Saw this one go down in the fighting at {place}.
rv.huginn.sickness: Huginn: Fever. Carried out of a farmhouse.
rv.huginn.oldAge: Huginn: Died in bed. Very old. Very dull.
rv.huginn.drowned: Huginn: The sea took this one. I watched from the mast.
rv.huginn.fledTrue: Huginn: Watched this one run for the boats.
rv.huginn.fledFalse: Huginn: This one never gave ground.
rv.huginn.weapon: Huginn: Weapon in hand to the last.
rv.huginn.noWeapon: Huginn: Dropped the weapon early. Very early.
rv.muninn.forgot: Muninn: I... forget. It'll come to me.
q.cause.braggart.confess.2: But I was planning a glorious death. Next spring.
q.cause.confess.1: All right. It wasn't a battle.
q.cause.drowned.confess.1: The deck was slippery. I went over. There. Happy?
q.grip.confess.1: I may have dropped it. Briefly. At the start.
q.fled.confess.1: They were very large men. I made a tactical decision.
q.fled.coward.excuse.1: I was looking for a better angle. Behind me.
q.any.excuse.1: It was dark. Things happened. Who can say?

ui.howto: Look the dead over, read what they tell you, catch the liars, and stamp each soul before the sun sets.

ui.rules.costs: A compare that finds nothing costs {bad}s. Questioning a liar costs {q}s.

ui.paused.body: The sun waits. The desk stays hidden until you return.
ui.ravens.none: No raven came for this one.

ui.report.title: Report this soul
ui.report.body: If a judgment looks wrong, send this. It holds the soul's seed and what you did with it, so the case can be rebuilt and checked, plus your browser, screen size and language. Nothing else.
ui.report.copyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the text above
ui.report.dispute: Think this is wrong? Report it
ui.guard.mismatch: This device built a different Daily from everyone else's, so your result won't be comparable. Please report it: it helps fix the game.
ui.telemetry.ask.title: Help tune the game?
ui.telemetry.ask.body: During the alpha you can send anonymous results: for each soul, the rule that applied, what you stamped, how long it took, the tools you used and which kinds of sign you checked or missed. No account, no ID, no names. You can turn it off in Settings.
ui.campaign.hint.demo: Days 1 to 3 of the story: the gate, your family at home, and a stranger who admires the dead.
ui.campaign.hint.full: Twenty days to Ragnarök. Judge the slain, keep your family fed, and pick your gods carefully.
